label: 02 · Idiomatic ports
description: Six strict workflows: code owns Git, tests and writes; named profiles, durable decisions and isolated edits make recovery measurable.
validation: Root-strict TypeScript and CLI validation, paired inert-harness fixtures, real temporary Git/test commands, actual SIGKILL recovery, and recorded F1–F5 metrics. No live agents; results measure orchestration contracts, not model quality.
commonChanges: Each entrypoint has required described inputs, bounded numeric controls and a domain output schema. Shared reader/writer profiles replace global $claude spreads. Call counts are measured fixture paths, not estimated savings.
Git revisions, manifests, test exit codes, hashes and publications are code-owned named effects. All source snapshots are the same immutable upstream files as Batch 01.
Bootstrap approves one canonical plan digest before isolated setters. SDLC uses typed inline children and stage-local durable questions. Answers and completed work replay in the same run.

Bug-hunt settles panels and counts failed or skipped members. The logical-call cap complements the runtime reported-cost/attempt admission gates; unknown costs and in-flight overshoot remain visible limitations.

The mutation worker reconciles only pristine bytes or its own exact interrupted mutant before retrying, then restores after an ordinary test exit. Unknown external edits are refused; no general filesystem rollback or exactly-once claim is made.

The rewrites keep the workflow purpose and source names while changing mechanics and some interfaces. Test-gap-filler discovers and ranks gaps within an operator-selected source file and command; SDLC uses compact typed document/implementation/verification children. These are not claims of equivalent model quality or identical agent work.

apiSnapshot.description: Validated against the quiet-choir API whose model file has this hash: typed harness registry, inline children, durable commands/files, worktrees, questions, settled maps and usage gates, plus the #65 recovery for owned interrupted worktree registrations. Both batches compile under the root strict settings; Batch 01 has 70 baseline fixtures and Batch 02 owns active primitive acceptance with a paired F1–F5 matrix. This model-file hash is provenance for that file, not the entire runtime; tests use the built checkout. Storage format 7 retains replay contract 6.
